Team — looping in a quick execution plan based on Aisha/Sophia's notes. See inline for the proposed test matrix and measurement rules.

Execution summary:
- Platforms to test (3): Redwood Hosted API (r-hosted/region-us), Redwood Dedicated (r-dedicated/atlas-pool), HyperCloud inference endpoint (hypercloud://atlas-hc).
- Measurement windows: 15 minutes per configuration, repeated 3x to get distribution. Report p50/p90/p95/p99, mean, stddev, and tokens/sec. Include 95% CI for p99 when possible.
- Cold vs warm runs: run an initial priming phase (500 requests, small) then measure warm runs. Also capture cold-start latency from a clean node for 10 requests.

Test matrix (short):
- sequence lengths: 32, 128, 512 tokens
- batch sizes: 1, 8, 32
- concurrency levels: 1, 8, 32 (measured at client side)
- prompt set: use the attached prompt-set-sample.txt and atlas-traffic-sample.json as request templates

Measurement instrument: wrk-like harness for steady load; record token output/sec at server-side (when available) and client-observed tokens/sec. Collect logs (latency histograms) and kernel-level stats if we can access dedicated nodes.

Deliverables:
- Raw CSVs: per-run histograms and request traces (redwood will host on s3).
- Summary dashboard: p50/p95/p99 charts, tokens/sec heatmap, cost-estimate table (cost-per-1M tokens).

Operational asks: Evelyn — can we reserve a small dedicated pool for May 13 (US-west) for two 1-hour windows? If not available, we'll run hosted and tag the results. Evelyn, also please confirm access for collecting server-side token metrics if dedicated is granted.

Sophia — if you approve, we'll invite HyperCloud to the test and share a concise test spec doc and a one-click runner they can use. We should also sign a short test NDA before exchanging any credentials.
